introHtml: Gold luggage ID tags offer a distinctive way to brand your company's travel accessories while ensuring bags are easily identifiable. The metallic finish pairs well with foil stamping or screen printing for crisp logos. Whether for corporate travel gifts or employee recognition, these tags add a touch of professionalism that standard plastic tags cannot match.
